context.description: GearCrester is a modular World of Warcraft addon for Midnight that analyzes equipped gear, crest currencies, and upgrade tracks to recommend optimal crest spending. It does NOT simulate performance or stat weights.
context.architecture: The addon is structured into Core, Modules, and UI folders. Each module has a single responsibility. No business logic is allowed in UI files. Upgrade logic lives in Modules/UpgradeAdvisor.
rules: Do not create global variables except GC and SavedVariables.
Do not mix UI logic with data logic.
All new modules must be placed in the appropriate folder.
Never compute stat weights or performance simulation.

style.comments: Use concise, meaningful comments above functions.
